name: app-tour
instructions: Demo Studio's own product tour. Cold open on the cost-of-demos question, then: open a project, Gemini framing, the editable shot list, studio voices, one-click run. Close on 'this demo was built with this tool' and the specialized-tool CTA. Confident, outcome-led, ~60 seconds.

narration.text: How many hours does your team spend on a single product demo? They are not cheap, and this entire video came from one click.
Point it at a project folder or any live URL, and it builds the demo around the real page, nothing staged.
You describe the story in plain English, and Gemini reads the page, writes the narration, and plans every shot.
The shot list stays yours, so every spotlight, caption and camera move is editable, right down to the raw JSON.
Pick a studio voice from Google, or draft offline for free, and hear a sample before you commit.
Then one click records the page, times the picture to the voice, and delivers an upload-safe cut.
And everything you just watched was produced by Demo Studio itself. Want a specialized demo tool for your needs? Reach out, Tom at Ops G S dot com.
